sections.title: Executive Summary & Market Imperative
sections.content: Cross-border B2B transactions incur $14B annually in compliance delays and false-positive sanctions freezes. NexusPay orchestrates real-time regulatory mapping between EU Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) and US FinCEN guidelines.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: bis_report] Cross-border payment friction costs 2.4% of total transaction value

sections.title: Dual-Jurisdiction Regulatory Engine
sections.content: Autonomous parser reconciles EU MiCA whitepaper authorization requirements with FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) thresholds. Dynamic sanctions filtering against OFAC, EU Consolidated, and UN lists in under 45ms.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: mica_regulation] EU 2023/1114 Titles III and IV compliance mandates

sections.title: High-Throughput Streaming Infrastructure
sections.content: Event-driven Apache Kafka pipeline deployed across redundant multi-region AWS and GCP VPCs. Real-time transaction graph inspection utilizes distributed Graph Neural Networks for AML anomaly detection with sub-100ms P99 latency.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: latency_benchmarks] 12,000 TPS sustained transaction validation capacity

sections.title: Enterprise Sales & Implementation Cycle
sections.content: Enterprise SaaS pricing structured at $3,500/month platform tier + $0.04 per cleared transaction. Targeted at tier-2 banks, neo-brokers, and multi-currency treasury platforms.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: banking_benchmark] Average bank compliance software spend up 26% YoY

sections.title: Compliance Officer Copilot UX
sections.content: Audit-ready web console surfaces explainable AI decision paths for flagged transactions. One-click SAR draft generation eliminates 4 hours of manual case documentation per escalation.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: fatf_guidance] Explainability standards for automated AML reporting

sections.title: Evasion & Smurfing Adversarial Testing
sections.content: Red team stress-tests cross-border 'smurfing' (splitting transactions under the $10,000 FinCEN reporting threshold). Temporal graph aggregation successfully links structured transactions across distributed wallets.
